topics.topic: Required-test coverage of A03-2 for Project correction and preservation of non-editable Project facts
questions: Must A03-2 be shown for project correction, Customer correction, or both? The only item bound to A03-2 describes a Customer, while the formal formula uses correct(p) and the project rule also promises preservation of non-editable facts.
What Required test shows that correcting a Project preserves all of that Project's non-editable facts, rather than showing A03-2 only for a Customer?
Which Required test shows A03-2 for a Project correction, including preservation of identity, status, marks, instants and request id?

quotes:
after correct(p, facts f) accepted:
  editable(p) = f   -- A03-1
  non_editable(p) = non_editable(p before)   -- A03-2
  f = editable(p before) => p = p before   -- A03-3

4. A Customer correction replaces every editable fact, clearing an optional
   one it does not give; its identity, created instant, request id and marks
   stay; one giving exactly the stored facts leaves the revision.
   Shows A03-1, A03-2, A03-3. [witness: verification:registry_a03_customer_correction_replaces_editable_facts]
judgement.divergence: A Project correction may preserve every non-editable fact or may lose or rewrite one while the only Required test that says it shows A03-2 describes a Customer; the owner later reading the Project or retrying its create observes the violation.
judgement.why: A03-2 applies to Project correction, but no Required tests item says that Project non-editable-fact preservation must be shown.
options: Add a Project non-editable-facts preservation test
Expand a Project-correction Required test to name every preserved non-editable fact
Restrict A03-2 to Customer correction
consequences: Without a Project case, an implementation can violate A03-2 while satisfying the stated Customer-only evidence.
